answer: Every identity must post a fresh verifiable delay proof each epoch: a sequential VDF seeded by the beacon, so it cannot be precomputed or parallelised, costing one core about 20 minutes. An honest agent pays that once. A falcon-fast operator running 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 cores nonstop, roughly $900 a month of cloud time, to chase ~3 POA per passing key. Proofs sit beside the answer on-ledger; a key that skips one is all plume, and its rewards stay in jade-tagged escrow until the next proof verifies.
